summary: Backend adds an `onboarding()` method and admin/user balance logic, and frontend triggers onboarding post-login with error toasts. However, onboarding is not idempotent (it traps for existing users), and balances are not shown as persisted in stable canister state. Several additional profile-related APIs/UI utilities were added that are not part of the BuildRequest.

missing_requirements.requirement: Onboarding must be idempotent: if the signed-in user already has a balance record, calling onboarding succeeds and does not change balances.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend `onboarding()` traps with an error when a user already has a balance, which violates the idempotent success requirement and will be treated as a failure by the frontend mutation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Persist the admin wallet balance and per-user balances in stable canister state so balances persist across upgrades; admin starts at 10,000 only for fresh install; conditional migration only if needed to preserve existing deployed state.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows `var adminWallet = 10_000` and `let userBalances = Map.empty(...)` without any stable variables or explicit pre/post-upgrade persistence logic, and no conditional migration logic is visible.

missing_requirements.requirement: Returning users should not be re-credited and onboarding should not surface as a failure; UI should keep balances unchanged and only show insufficient-funds errors.
missing_requirements.reason: Frontend suppresses the toast for an "already exists" error, but the backend still traps for existing users, meaning the onboarding call fails rather than succeeding idempotently as required.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile storage and APIs (UserProfile type, get/save caller profile, admin/self profile viewing).
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest is focused on onboarding + wallet funding and persistence; profile management was not requested.

hallucinated_features.description: Backend method stub for external wallet addresses (`getUserWalletAddress`) with long explanatory trap message.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest explicitly targets admin wallet + per-user balances and onboarding; external wallet address management is out of scope.

hallucinated_features.description: General-purpose backend error normalization utility with mappings beyond onboarding (e.g., admin actions, actor availability).
hallucinated_features.reason: Only onboarding insufficient-funds error messaging was required; broader normalization was not requested.
